 2. VICTIM X THROUGH P.S. RAJGARH DISTRICT  DHAR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .
(NONE PRESENT AS THE ADVOCATES ARE ABSTAINING FROM WORK)
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
ORDER Perused the case-diary which is made available by the office of the Advocate General.

This is the first bail application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code,
1973 as he is implicated in connection with Crime No.22/2023 registered at Police Station - Rajgarh,
District - Dhar (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(n), 368, 506/34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of POCSO Act.
T h e applicant is in custody since 07.02.2023.

On the last date of hearing, counsel for the objector has sought time to file reply, however, neither objection is filed, nor the counsel has appeared as the Advocates are abstaining from work today.

sentences.text:
On due consideration of the statements of the prosecutrix under Sections 164 and 161 of Cr.P.C.,
wherein, she has not even named the present applicant.
Thus, considering the fact that the applicant is 18 years old and there are no criminal antecedents, this Court is inclined to allow the present application.
Accordingly, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the present application for grant of bail is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance, as and when directed and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
C.c.
